nodes.description: Public address state variable initialized from msg.sender at deployment; acts as the trusted owner reference used by access control checks.
Public uint state variable holding the last completed migration index; writable through setCompleted.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the restricted modifier; its only effect is writing last_completed_migration.
Modifier-style guard function containing require(msg.sender == owner); acts as the access control gate for setCompleted.
Caller-controlled address used both to initialize owner and to satisfy the restricted modifier check.
Function parameter of setCompleted(uint completed) carrying the migration index to persist.
Privileged state mutation last_completed_migration = completed; protection relies solely on the restricted modifier.

edges.reason: owner is initialized directly from the untrusted caller address msg.sender at construction time, establishing the trusted principal for all later access checks.
The restricted guard compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner value, so caller identity flows into the access control decision.
The restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted, so the access control check must succeed before the function body runs.
The completed parameter flows into the state write executed inside the function body.
setCompleted performs the state write to last_completed_migration as its sole body statement.
The assignment operation updates the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter has no independent semantic role; its only purpose is to supply the value for the privileged state write represented by node 6, so it is collapsed into that unsafe operation.
